## Description

Converts every `.eps` and/or `.pdf` file under a path to PNG with ImageMagick's `convert`, writing `<name>.png` next to each file. The pipeline runs it inside the Docker image given by `DockerImg` (default `dpokidov/imagemagick`), which provides `convert`.

## Usage

```bash
./automations/52_convert_eps_pdf.sh -p <path> -e <yes|no> -d <yes|no>
```

- `-p` - Directory to search, relative to the current directory.
- `-e` - `yes` to convert EPS files.
- `-d` - `yes` to convert PDF files.
